desc_short: Lincoln Financial Field: football stadium with midnight green seats, three-tier sidelines under steel canopy roofs, open corners, glass and steel facade
Chase Center: round arena with a smooth white curved roof, white and silver horizontal panel bands, glass base, plaza with terraces
Target Field: tan limestone ballpark with dark green seats, a white canopy over the upper deck, large left field scoreboard, tight downtown site
Providence Park: compact rectangular soccer stadium with green seats, steel canopy roofs, a tall modern east stand, historic brick west facade, green pitch
Neyland Stadium: huge closed college football bowl with orange and white seats, orange and white checkerboard end zones, tall sideline decks, gray concrete exterior
Rose Bowl: low elliptical bowl with a continuous rim and light red seats, press box on one side, set among trees, green grass field
Oriole Park at Camden Yards: brick ballpark with a long eight-story red brick warehouse behind right field, dark green seats, steel truss roof, grass field
